title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Covers fundamentals, evaluation, and feature engineering.

questions.question: Which of the following is the primary goal of supervised learning?
options: To predict a target using labeled examples
questions.explanation: Supervised learning learns mappings from labeled examples to target outputs.

questions.question: Why is cross-validation useful?
options: It removes all need for data cleaning
It gives a more stable estimate of generalization performance
questions.explanation: Cross-validation helps estimate model performance on unseen data while reducing variance.

questions.question: What is the purpose of feature scaling?
options: To make features comparable for algorithms sensitive to magnitude
questions.explanation: Scaling helps algorithms like k-NN and logistic regression perform better when feature magnitudes differ.

questions.question: A model that memorizes training data and performs poorly on unseen data is exhibiting what issue?
questions.explanation: Overfitting occurs when a model captures training noise and fails to generalize.

title: Data Science Foundations
description: Assesses core analytics, visualization, and statistical reasoning for data science roles.

questions.question: Which metric is most commonly used to summarize the average of a numeric dataset?
questions.explanation: The mean is the arithmetic average and is often used for numeric summaries.

questions.question: Why is missing-value handling important in analytics workflows?
options: It guarantees better model accuracy on every dataset
It prevents biased or misleading insights from incomplete data
It removes the need for validation
questions.explanation: Missing values can distort analysis and bias models if not handled appropriately.

questions.question: Which plot is best suited for showing the distribution of a single numeric variable?
questions.explanation: A histogram is specifically designed to show the distribution of values for one variable.

questions.question: What is the purpose of using a validation set when evaluating a model?
options: To ensure the final code runs without errors
To estimate how well the model generalizes to unseen data
To reduce the number of features
questions.explanation: A validation set helps estimate generalization performance without testing on the final full dataset.

title: Deep Learning Essentials
description: Assesses neural net basics and optimization.

questions.question: What is the role of an activation function in a neural network?
questions.explanation: Activation functions allow neural networks to learn nonlinear decision boundaries.

questions.question: Which optimization technique is commonly used to train neural networks?
questions.explanation: Gradient descent updates weights by moving in the direction of negative gradient.

questions.question: In PyTorch, what is a common way to define a model?
questions.explanation: PyTorch models are typically built with nn.Module subclasses.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a validation set?
options: To measure performance on unseen data during training
questions.explanation: A validation set helps monitor generalization during model development.

title: Software Engineering Foundations
description: Assesses programming, algorithms, testing, and API development fundamentals.

questions.question: Which data structure follows a last-in, first-out access pattern?
questions.explanation: A stack removes the most recently added element first.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a unit test?
options: Test one small behavior in isolation
questions.explanation: Unit tests verify focused behavior independently from the rest of the system.

questions.question: Which HTTP method is conventionally used to create a new resource?
questions.explanation: POST is conventionally used for resource creation.

questions.question: Why is version control useful in a software project?
options: It removes the need for tests
It tracks changes and enables collaboration
questions.explanation: Version control records change history and supports safe collaboration.
